item.title: GEAR UP Southern West Virginia registrations for WVU Tech STEM Camp open on March 9 with grant funding opportunities available for students
item.description: High school students in southern West Virginia will have an opportunity to explore science and technology this summer through a special camp at West Virginia University Institute of Technology in Beckley. The GEAR UP Southern West Virginia (GEAR UP SWV) WV Tech STEM Camp will run June 29 through July 1 and is designed as an immersive environmental science overnight experience. Students may also be able to receive financial help through the GEAR UP Southern West Virginia Summer Camp Grant Program
